about: Hand-computed expectations of non-text.html (read by the tests, not by --expect). Check non-text, threshold 3:1.

formulas.gradient: pixel column x of a 240 px panel from #fff to #b0b0b0: v = 255 - 79 * (x + 0.5) / 240; the 784 ring samples give the 1st percentile on the darkest column (x = 201, v = 189) for a black border and on the lightest column (x = 38, v = 242) for a white fill
